source: Native GameplaySession (platform/engine/Plugins/Activities/Skate), recorded with Tests/ride_oracle.py and Tests/Native/ride_oracle_recorder.cpp

conventions.tick: 1/60 s; scenario tick 0 is the state right after Launch(velocity), tick n after n pad steps
conventions.units: metres, seconds, degrees where a key says deg
conventions.space: native: x left, y up, z forward; heading 0 rides toward +z; rotations right-handed

pad.sticks: raw -32767..32767, +x right, +y up; conditioned = (|raw|/32768 - 0.25) x 1.4286, clamped to 0..1 along the stick direction
pad.triggers: 0..255 (255 on the ground is a ground grab; 1..254 crouches / pumps)

conventions.stance: regular unless the scenario uses the goofy tuning; the game mirrors Flick-It pattern names for a regular rider (pattern Heelflip gives a kickflip)
conventions.clips: clip segments: layer is the blend node or channel the clip played in; weight its effective share of the evaluated pose (product of the blend weights above it); time the clip time in seconds at the segment start and end; rate the median playback rate; loops the number of wraps
conventions.graph_states: last three levels of the motion / action graph state path
conventions.rotations: deck rotations sum the per-tick rotation about the moving deck axes (right-handed; x left, y up, z forward): roll about forward (+ lifts the left edge), yaw about up (+ turns the nose toward +x, left), pitch about left (+ drops the nose); world_yaw is the turn of the deck forward axis about world up (the shove-it part); board spin ticks bound the deck turning faster than 240 deg/s; combined flips leak some shove-it into roll

bail_reasons.0: body or arm contact force over the regional limit
bail_reasons.1: pose displacement (rider pulled off his target)
bail_reasons.2: deck acceleration in the board plane

gestures.note: conditioned stick points, +y up; a node starts within the tolerance (0.35-0.55) of the first point and must reach each next point within ~10 missed ticks; GestureSpeed = 1 when ticks/points <= 1.75, 0 at >= 4.4

stand/idle.note: Standing still on flat ground: hips over deck, stance

numbers.note: bones_in_deck_frame: [left, up, forward] metres from the published SKATEBOARD_ROOT along the physical deck axes; animation_bones_in_board_frame: the same from the clip pose (root space) along the animated board bone axes
